headline: Packaging Corporation Of America (PKG) On Strong Earnings And Higher Prices Looks Fully Valued
summary: Packaging Corporation of America (PKG) is back in focus after reporting second quarter 2026 results that topped its own guidance, supported by strong corrugated demand, record shipments, and contributions from recently acquired Greif assets.
